entries.subject: Owned-environment Windows x86_64 libmpv source-captured build
evidence: failed step: Build the Clang toolchain and package Windows libmpv
ld.lld: error: Not an int attribute (Producer: 'LLVM23.1.0-rust-1.100.0-nightly' Reader: 'LLVM 22.1.8')
entries.summary: The pinned recipe completed the toolchain and dependency builds, then failed while linking mpv.exe and libmpv-2.dll because Rust ThinLTO bitcode from LLVM 23 was read by LLVM 22.1.8.
limitations: No Windows binary artifact was produced.
No corresponding-source artifact was produced.
Only the build-log artifact was uploaded; this is not a DLL or product acceptance result.
entries.next_action: Disable package ThinLTO, enforce the cached setting before source download, run the narrow workflow and continuity tests, then request separate commit approval.
